propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena's symbol tools despite documentation because bash is in-hand while symbol tools incur discovery friction and an extra ToolSearch round-trip
Serena's symbol resolution fails on symbols referenced as string literals (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns) which grep can find
Serena's index lags behind recent edits while grep searches the current tree, yet grep produces false positives (comments) that LSP avoids
A PreToolUse hook on Bash commands must surface a reminder at the moment of grep invocation, naming both the preferred path (Serena) and its legitimate exceptions
AGENTS.md guidance must encode the division of labour (LSP for direct references, grep for string literals and recent edits) rather than a bare preference
A project-specific criterion and coaching move via .rebar/ overlay must detect and redirect hand-enumerated source references to re-derivation via Serena
